Citizen's Account payment date

Shows the days and hours until the next Citizen's Account deposit and the following dates in Gregorian and Hijri.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

The deposit rule

  • The 10th of each Gregorian month, the same rule since 2017.
  • Friday: the deposit moves to Thursday the 9th.
  • Saturday: the deposit moves to Sunday the 11th.
  • Public holidays: the programme states no rule; the first case ahead is March 2027 during Eid al-Fitr.

The extra support has been extended to 31 December 2026 and amounts may change in 2027; the deposit day is not affected. For salaries, social security and Hafiz see the monthly payment calendar.

Frequently asked questions

When is the November 2026 Citizen's Account payment?

Tuesday 10 November 2026 (30 Jumada al-Ula 1448), on time.

What if the 10th falls on a Friday or Saturday?

On a Friday the deposit comes on Thursday the 9th, and on a Saturday on Sunday the 11th, according to the programme's FAQs. In 2027 the April and July deposits come on the 11th, and September and December on the 9th.

When is the March 2027 deposit, during Eid?

Nominally Wednesday 10 March 2027, which is 2 Shawwal 1448 (Eid al-Fitr) by Umm al-Qura. The programme states no rule for public holidays, so watch for the official announcement.
